summary_md: **VidotStudio ([@VidotStudio](https://x.com/VidotStudio/status/2116195907360493780))** presents **Vidot Cut Manager**, a ComfyUI plugin that breaks a story into cuts, generates each shot with LTX and lets you pick takes on a rough-cut timeline ([passionfx-ui/vidot-cut-manager](https://github.com/passionfx-ui/vidot-cut-manager), [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=htpAatfaaeM&feature=youtu.be)).
